events.factual_description: Blue Note New York lists Reuben James featuring Chris Dave and David "DJ" Ginyard performing Big People Music on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, with sets at 8:00 PM and 10:30 PM. The club identifies James as a British pianist, songwriter and bandleader whose music combines jazz, soul, funk and contemporary R&B, and identifies Chris Dave as a drummer, bandleader and producer. David "DJ" Ginyard is independently documented as a bassist in current professional credits. Reuben James's official site presents Big People Music as his current full-length project; Apple Music verifies the album was released May 16, 2025.

en.why_it_matters: The admission case is the rhythm section as much as James himself. Big People Music lives between jazz harmony, British soul, funk and contemporary R&B; putting James's piano in a small room with Chris Dave's fractured, elastic time and David Ginyard's bass turns those songs into a live groove laboratory rather than a polished album reproduction. Blue Note also frames these as part of James's first U.S. headline shows, giving the booking a useful moment-in-career context without pretending it is a once-ever event.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two sets if New York is already in the regional plan and piano, pocket and contemporary jazz/R&B crossover are in the listening thread. The lineup is specific enough to anchor a night in the city, but I would not rebuild the entire DMV-to-NYC trip around it ahead of a rarer farewell, premiere or one-off master encounter.

es.why_it_matters: El argumento de admisión está tanto en la sección rítmica como en James. Big People Music vive entre armonía de jazz, soul británico, funk y R&B contemporáneo; poner el piano de James en una sala pequeña con el tiempo quebrado y elástico de Chris Dave y el bajo de David Ginyard convierte esas canciones en un laboratorio de groove en vivo, no en una reproducción pulida del disco. Blue Note además presenta estas fechas como parte de los primeros shows de James como headliner en Estados Unidos: contexto real de carrera, sin venderlo como un acontecimiento irrepetible.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets si Nueva York ya está dentro del plan regional y piano, pocket y el cruce jazz/R&B contemporáneo están en el hilo. La alineación alcanza para construir una noche alrededor del concierto, pero no rehacería todo el viaje DMV–NYC por encima de una despedida, estreno o encuentro con un maestro realmente más raro.
